Is end-to-end encryption available for meetings? Which features are disabled when it is on?
Are security events logged and monitored? Can the customer get admin and sign-in audit logs?
Is there regular vulnerability scanning and independent penetration testing? Is there a bug bounty?
Does Zoom follow a secure SDLC with code review and security testing before release?

Does Zoom publish a subprocessor list and notify customers of changes?
